entries.title: Base event vocabulary coherence
entries.requirement: Candidate §24.2 base events are machine-coherent with the controlled registry and event schema.

entries.title: Base error vocabulary coherence
entries.requirement: Candidate §34.2 base errors are present in the controlled registry and Problem Details contract.

entries.title: not_applicable outcome semantics
entries.requirement: not_applicable is a normal outcome only for policy/profile non-applicability and carries stable reasons.

entries.title: Half-open lower and upper bounds
entries.requirement: effective_from is inclusive and effective_until is exclusive.

entries.title: Clock-profile discoverability
entries.requirement: Material clock skew and precision are policy/profile-visible and ambiguous state remains non-affirmative.

entries.title: Collective snapshot binding
entries.requirement: Collective approvals are evaluated against one stated membership/rule snapshot unless explicit cross-snapshot composition is proven.

entries.title: Parent authority linkage
entries.requirement: Delegated authority exposes one canonical derives_from parent reference.

entries.title: Problem Details type URI
entries.requirement: ARPA Problem Details uses stable code values and deterministic project-controlled type URIs.

entries.title: Media type preservation
entries.requirement: application/agent-registry+json remains preferred; application/json is semantics-identical fallback.

entries.title: Extension namespace authority
entries.requirement: Active project namespaces use qbfconsulting.digital and placeholder arpa.example identifiers are deprecated.
